cands.name: Scott Franklin
cands.bio: Republican, Navy veteran (naval aviator, retired Commander after 26 years active and reserve) and former CEO of a Lakeland insurance agency. Lakeland city commissioner 2017-2021; U.S. House since 2021. On the new 2026 map, District 18 is centered on Polk County with part of Osceola County.
cands.local_ties: Raised in Lakeland; his district now centers on Polk County (Lakeland).

record.text: Sits on the House Appropriations Committee (his office lists Military Construction/VA, Agriculture/FDA and Energy and Water subcommittees); Speaker Johnson named him a House appropriations conferee in Sept 2025 (per his office's releases).
Navy career, local-government service (Lakeland City Commission, elected 2017) and insurance-agency CEO background per Wikipedia.
2020 GOP primary: defeated incumbent Rep. Ross Spano 51.2%-48.8%; re-elected 2022 (74.7%) and 2024 (65.3%).

money_notes.text: Wikipedia's 2026 election page lists AIPAC and Associated Builders and Contractors (Florida Gulf Coast chapter) among his endorsers; no outside super PAC spending in this race was found.

endorsements.text: Donald Trump; AIPAC; Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast Chapter (as listed on Wikipedia's 2026 FL House elections page).

cands.gaps: No controversy section found in Wikipedia; no outside-spending data found. Owner-source search returned no hits for Franklin.
